svg.aria-label: The exit desk takes shMON from the vault's leavers, from anyone selling into its EulerSwap pool and from the arbitrage keeper; leavers' shMON sells on Curve first, the rest goes the borrow route through the WMON vault and shMonad's one-day unstake; the desk sells WMON for USDC through its digester ladder, which the keeper fills against outside pools.

g.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: shMON in
Vault leavers
They wait in a withdrawal batch.
Their shMON sells on Curve first.
Curve must stay within 0.15% of rate.
The rest takes the borrow route.
Anyone selling shMON
They sell into the desk's EulerSwap pool.
They get WMON at once.
The price is 0.30% under shMonad's rate.
The pool stops while leavers wait.
Arbitrage keeper
It buys shMON where a pool sells cheap.
It sells that shMON into our pool.
Both trades run in one transaction.
Its WMON gain goes to the desk.
Euler WMON vault
0xE452…0eaf
It lends WMON against ushMON.
It lends at 93% and liquidates at 95%.
shMonad unstake
It turns shMON into MON in about a day.
That MON repays the WMON loan.
Exit desk, one per vault
Delta One 0x02Df…c770 · Delta Neutral 0xF460…6CdE
Leavers, Curve first
Any amount over $10 sells on Curve within 0.15% average cost.
The WMON it gets goes to the digester.
Leavers, the borrow route
The rest comes to the desk in chunks.
The desk parks each chunk in ushMON and unstakes it.
It borrows WMON against it, and the digester sells that WMON.
Chunk size
A chunk is the smallest of three amounts.
They are what is left, 4 hours of pace, or 92% of lender room.
Chunks run one at a time, and under $1,000 swaps at market.
Pace
The pace is a quarter of the MON takers bought per hour.
It counts seven outside venues over the last day.
Oracle floor
The desk sells at most 1% under the oracle, or 2% at 65%.
Its own EulerSwap pool
It buys anyone's shMON at shMonad's rate less 0.30%.
Routers and aggregators reach it as a Uniswap v4 pool.
It only buys, and quotes nothing while leavers wait.
pools 0x56aE…28A8 · 0x1924…e8a8
Paused
It still parks, borrows, sells and rests orders.
where it sells
Curve MON LSTs pool
It trades shMON for WMON at a 0.01% fee.
The vault's Curve adapter makes the sale.
Average cost stays within 0.15% of rate.
Digester ladder
v4 WMON/USDC 0.01% · hook 0x94Df…1040
Five sell orders rest 1 to 5 ticks over.
Five buy orders rest 2 to 6 ticks under.
An order 20 ticks behind for 3 min resets.
Stray bids are taken at once.
Exit bid pools, empty today
USDC 0xEA93…C4a9 · WMON 0xB03b…D716
They would take shMON, USDC pool first.
Neither holds a bid, so nothing sells.
Old resting venues
Both desks use the digester, never these.
Uniswap v3 0.3% · PancakeSwap v3 0.05%
PancakeSwap AUSD/WMON · v4 0.05%, 0.001%
Hanji MON/USDC book
Stable desk
It is an EulerSwap USDC/USDT0 pool.
It moves debt between USDC and USDT0.
Its price comes from Curve 0x9426…91ab.
What goes home to the vault
The digester's USDC pays the withdrawal batch.
The pool's 0.30% and the arbitrage gain come home as shMON once the loan is repaid.
The keeper's gain on each digester fill goes to the vault's controller.
Who fills the digester, and what prices the fills
Flow venues the pace counts
Uniswap v3 0.3% · PancakeSwap v3 0.05%
PancakeSwap AUSD/WMON · v4 0.05%, 0.001%
Hanji · Kuru, in 5-minute buckets
Our own trades are left out.
Pools the keeper prices against
MON/USDC: Uniswap v4 0.05%, Uniswap v3 0.3%,
PancakeSwap v3 0.05%; Hanji when no pool fills
shMON/WMON for arbitrage: Curve MON LSTs,
Uniswap v3 0.01% and 0.3%,
PancakeSwap v3 0.01%
Digester keeper
key 0xEE51…c3A7
router 0xe1fe…3776
It wakes on every swap by websocket.
It fills orders outside prices have passed.
The gap must beat both pools' fees.
Numbers
pool discount 0.30% · Curve limit 0.15% · pace share 25% of taker buys · chunk window 4 h · lenders' room used 92.15% · dust $10 · leftover floor $1,000
oracle floor 1%, 2% over 65% · rungs 5 per side · stale 20 ticks for 3 min · rested inside 5 min · WMON loan 93% of value, liquidation 95%
arbitrage: never while leavers wait; the WMON vault keeps half its cash, or the last leaver payout if larger · keeper fill minimum $0.01
v4 PoolManager 0x188d…Ea8e · v3 position manager 0x7197…4E53 · PancakeSwap position manager 0x46A1…4364
